requested_outcome: Add automated multilingual visual and localization-integrity checks that detect mixed-language content, layout collisions, clipping, direction errors and locale-loss navigation across VII public page families.
natural_destination: The recurring VII production browser QA run and its generated evidence reports.
authorization_boundary: May change and test the read-only QA runner and its scheduled prompts. No public-site content repair, deployment, booking, lead, call, WhatsApp, review, payment or other external write is authorized by this task.

lesson_bundle.reason: The current production QA passed while an obvious public multilingual defect remained visible.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: The exact public destination and representative route families must be exercised in every supported language on desktop and mobile, with reproducible failure evidence.

lesson_bundle.reason: The screenshots show Hebrew content and literal French strings inside an active French experience.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: The QA must fail on mixed-language leftovers, untranslated public content, rejected literal strings and locale-loss navigation.

lesson_bundle.reason: The preceding screenshot exposed a visual collision that whole-page overflow checks could not detect.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: The QA must measure clipping, off-screen elements and meaningful element collisions instead of relying only on screenshots or document width.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The checker tests the language selector but misses Hebrew content inside French cards and articles.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Inspect visible text nodes outside explicitly marked language-picker controls and report offending selectors and excerpts.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: A synthetic French fixture containing Hebrew review and article text fails with locale_script_leak evidence.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The checker catches page overflow but misses a card covering a headline.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Measure visible element rectangles and clipping, then test declared high-risk hero and card regions for intersections.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: A collision fixture fails while a deliberately layered overlay and a clean fixture pass.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Only the home page or only French is checked.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Run Hebrew, English, Russian and French against representative home, search, world, guide, gift-card and place-page routes on desktop and mobile.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The report inventory contains every language, viewport and route-family combination.

predicted_rejections.rejection: A click from a localized page silently returns to Hebrew.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Exercise representative internal card links and assert that the destination URL retains the active locale.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: A locale-dropping link fixture fails and the live navigation evidence records the final localized URL.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The run reports only a generic failure with no usable evidence.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Save a screenshot and structured JSON with URL, language, viewport, selector, text sample and bounding boxes for each failure.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Every failed case has a screenshot path and structured diagnostics.

affected_family: Hebrew, English, Russian and French public locales
home, search, world landing, guide, gift-card and place-page templates
visible text, direction, clipping, overlap and localized internal navigation
six-hour production QA and daily regression automation

sources.label: Five user screenshots showing an active French locale with Hebrew content and mixed directions
VII accepted multilingual and release behavior

midpoint_gate.trigger: After the detector and synthetic tests exist, before integrating it into the recurring production run.
checks: Hebrew leakage, clipping, collision and locale-loss fixtures fail with specific evidence
The supplied French public page is detected as failing rather than incorrectly passing

attack_questions: Can Hebrew text inside a French review card evade the scanner through nested elements or lang attributes?
Can an absolutely positioned card obscure a headline without increasing document scroll width?
Can internal navigation keep translated text but drop the locale in the destination URL?
Can a language-picker native label create a false positive?
Can a failure be reproduced from the saved screenshot and selector evidence?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: A production-mode QA report generated against https://vii.spaplus.co with failing French evidence and complete language/viewport inventory.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Unit fixtures plus production browser cases across all four languages and representative route families.

effectiveness.baseline: The existing production runner checks document-level overflow and Hebrew-only page families; it does not detect nested script leakage or arbitrary element collisions.
effectiveness.target: The supplied French defects produce deterministic failed cases with actionable evidence, while clean fixtures and native language-picker labels pass.
